parameters.text:
={{ '👀 *__CLIENT_NAME__* — a Fathom recording was NOT tracked. Its title matched none of the sales-call phrases.

Title: ' + ($('Fathom Webhook').item.json.body.meeting_title ?? 'untitled') + '
Recorded by: ' + ($('Fathom Webhook').item.json.body.recorded_by?.name ?? 'unknown') + '
Recording: ' + ($('Fathom Webhook').item.json.body.share_url ?? $('Fathom Webhook').item.json.body.url ?? 'no link') + '

If that was a sales call, the invite was titled wrong — or it was impromptu and has no invite at all. Log it by hand, and remind the closer of the title rule.' }}

nodes.name: Untracked — Alert
nodes.notes: Fires when a recording's title matched none of the sales-call phrases. Every client's workflow posts to the same Slack channel, so the message leads with the client name.

assignments.name: closer
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const body = $('Fathom Webhook').item.json.body; const internal = (body.calendar_invitees ?? []).filter(i => !i.is_external); if (internal.length === 0) return body.recorded_by?.name ?? 'Unassigned'; if (internal.length === 1) return internal[0].name; const t = body.transcript ?? []; const counts = internal.map(i => ({ name: i.name, lines: t.filter(s => s.speaker.display_name === i.name).length })); counts.sort((a, b) => b.lines - a.lines); return counts[0].lines > 0 ? counts[0].name : internal[0].name; })() }}

nodes.name: Extract Meeting Data
nodes.notes: With several internal people on the invite, the closer is the one who actually spoke the most in the transcript — not whoever Fathom happens to list first.

assignments.name: prospect_name
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = String($json.meeting_title ?? '').trim(); const i = t.indexOf(':'); if (i > 0) { const n = t.slice(0, i).trim(); if (n) return n; } const ext = ($('Fathom Webhook').item.json.body.calendar_invitees ?? []).filter(x => !!x && x.is_external && x.name); if (ext.length) return String(ext[0].name).trim(); return 'Unknown'; })() }}

nodes.name: Load Rubric
nodes.notes: Generated from rubric/rubric.json. Do not edit the prompt here — edit the rubric and re-run `npm run build:rubric`.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (() => { const d = $('Extract Direct Fields').item.json; return JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 32000, thinking: { type: 'adaptive' }, output_config: { effort: 'high', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: JSON.parse($json.output_schema) } }, system: $json.system_prompt, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Review this sales call.

THE CALLER (the person selling, the one you are scoring): ' + d.closer + '
PROSPECT: ' + d.prospect_name + '
ALL ATTENDEES: ' + d.attendees + '
CALL DATE: ' + d.call_date + '
DURATION: ' + d.duration_minutes + ' minutes

--- TRANSCRIPT ---

' + d.transcript }] }); })() }}

nodes.name: Claude Analysis
nodes.notes: Structured outputs guarantee the reply matches the rubric schema, so no JSON repair is needed downstream. Timeout is 5 minutes because scoring a long transcript with thinking enabled is not fast. Retries 3 times so a rate limit or an overloaded minute does not lose the call.

assignments.name: ai
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { if ($json.stop_reason === 'refusal') { throw new Error('Claude declined to score this call. stop_reason: refusal.'); } const block = ($json.content ?? []).find(b => b.type === 'text'); if (!block) { throw new Error('No text block in the Claude response. stop_reason: ' + $json.stop_reason); } return JSON.parse(block.text); })() }}

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: Finds the text block by type rather than taking content[0] — with thinking enabled the first block is a thinking block.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const ai = $json.ai; const d = $('Extract Direct Fields').item.json; const S = ai.scores; const DIMS = [['frame_ownership','Frame Ownership'],['discovery_depth','Discovery Depth'],['belief_architecture','Belief Architecture'],['pitch_precision','Pitch Precision'],['tension_management','Tension Management'],['objection_resolution','Objection Resolution'],['qualification','Qualification'],['strategic_awareness','Strategic Awareness']]; const vals = DIMS.map(k => S[k[0]].score).filter(v => v != null); const overall = vals.length ? Math.round((vals.reduce((t, v) => t + v, 0) / vals.length) * 10) / 10 : null; const verdict = overall == null ? null : overall >= 8.5 ? 'Elite execution' : overall >= 7 ? 'Strong call' : overall >= 5.5 ? 'Average' : 'Fundamentals need work'; const txt = (s) => [{ text: { content: String(s ?? '').slice(0, 1900) } }]; const blk = (type, s) => ({ object: 'block', type: type, [type]: { rich_text: txt(s) } }); const num = (v) => ({ number: (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? null : Number(v) }); const sel = (v) => v ? { select: { name: String(v) } } : { select: null }; const rt = (v) => ({ rich_text: v ? txt(v) : [] }); const yn = (v) => v ? 'yes' : 'no'; const children = [blk('heading_2', overall == null ? 'Scorecard: not scored — no evidence in the transcript' : 'Scorecard: ' + overall + '/10 — ' + verdict)].concat(DIMS.flatMap(k => [blk('heading_3', k[1] + ' — ' + (S[k[0]].score == null ? 'no evidence' : S[k[0]].score + '/10')), blk('paragraph', S[k[0]].reasoning)])).concat([{ object: 'block', type: 'divider', divider: {} }, blk('heading_2', 'The moment'), blk('paragraph', ai.narrative.the_moment), blk('heading_2', 'Next call drill'), blk('paragraph', ai.narrative.next_call_drill), blk('heading_2', 'Flags'), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Best moment: ' + ai.narrative.best_moment), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Biggest miss: ' + ai.narrative.biggest_miss), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Weakest belief: ' + ai.flags.weakest_belief), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Value leak: ' + yn(ai.flags.value_leak)), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Follow-up trap: ' + yn(ai.flags.follow_up_trap)), blk('bulleted_list_item', 'Early price drop: ' + yn(ai.flags.price_drop_too_early))]); const props = { 'Name': { title: txt(d.prospect_name || 'Unknown') }, 'Closer': sel(d.closer), 'Call Date': { date: { start: d.call_date } }, 'Outcome': sel(ai.outcome || 'No deal'), 'Tier': ai.tier ? { select: { name: 'Tier ' + ai.tier } } : { select: null }, 'Price Discussed': num(ai.price_discussed), 'Price Closed': num(ai.price_closed), 'Collected On Call': num(ai.collected_on_call), 'Payment Structure': sel(ai.payment_structure), 'Currency': sel(ai.currency), 'Prospect Revenue': rt(ai.prospect_revenue), 'Niche': rt(ai.niche), 'Location': rt(ai.location), 'Lead Source': sel(ai.lead_source), 'Quality Score': num(overall), 'Recording ID': num(d.recording_id), 'Rubric Version': rt($('Load Rubric').item.json.rubric_version), 'Value Leak': { checkbox: !!ai.flags.value_leak }, 'Follow-Up Trap': { checkbox: !!ai.flags.follow_up_trap }, 'Early Price Drop': { checkbox: !!ai.flags.price_drop_too_early }, 'Weakest Belief': sel(ai.flags.weakest_belief), 'The Moment': rt(ai.narrative.the_moment), 'Next Call Drill': rt(ai.narrative.next_call_drill), 'Duration (min)': num(d.duration_minutes), 'Recording URL': { url: d.share_url || null }, 'Summary': rt(ai.summary) }; DIMS.forEach(k => { props[k[1]] = num(S[k[0]].score); }); return JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_NOTION_DATABASE_ID' }, properties: props, children: children }); })() }}

nodes.name: Write to Notion
nodes.notes: Writes the eight dimension scores as columns and the full written breakdown as the page body. 'Quality Score' averages only the dimensions that had evidence — a null score is left out, not counted as zero. Retries 3 times so a transient Notion error does not lose the call.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filter: { property: 'Recording ID', number: { equals: $json.recording_id } }, page_size: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: Already Logged?
nodes.notes: Looks the recording up by Recording ID before doing anything expensive. A webhook redelivery or a manual re-run then skips instead of writing a duplicate row that double-counts cash and close rate.

nodes.name: Has Transcript?
nodes.notes: Under 50 words of transcript there is no call to score — a no-show or a recording failure. Scoring it anyway would fill the tracker with meaningless neutral numbers that drag every average.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Extract Direct Fields').item.json; const txt = (s) => [{ text: { content: String(s ?? '').slice(0, 1900) } }]; return JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_NOTION_DATABASE_ID' }, properties: { 'Name': { title: txt(d.prospect_name || 'Unknown') }, 'Closer': d.closer ? { select: { name: String(d.closer) } } : { select: null }, 'Call Date': { date: { start: d.call_date } }, 'Duration (min)': { number: d.duration_minutes ?? null }, 'Recording URL': { url: d.share_url || null }, 'Recording ID': { number: d.recording_id ?? null }, 'Outcome': { select: { name: 'No show' } }, 'Summary': { rich_text: txt('No usable transcript came through (under 50 words), so this call was not scored. Logged as a no-show — check the recording and correct the outcome if that is wrong.') } } }); })() }}

nodes.name: Log No-Show
nodes.notes: The call still gets a row — outcome, closer, date, recording link — just no scorecard.
